run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable and print its average execution time in milliseconds
test_time_func_warmup: test time_func warmup phase which runs 5 iterations before timing begins
test_time_func_iterations: test time_func with a custom number of iterations to control benchmark precision
review_time_func_output: review time_func output format which prints the function name and average time in ms
summarize_time_func: summarize time_func which benchmarks a callable using perf_counter and reports average ms per call
